edit.description: readPendingTolerant: readFile joins the stat catch's declared degrade
stattable-but-unreadable pending.json case, beside the ELOOP one

summary: readPendingTolerant's readFile is bare — fold it into the same warn-then-[] degrade its stat and parse branches already declare
tests: readPendingTolerant warns and reports an empty pendingAfter when pending.json stats but cannot be read
acceptance: A tick whose pending.json stats but fails to read still returns its TickResult, with the read error warned.
notes: EISDIR (a directory at the path), EACCES on the file's own mode, a delete racing the probe. Both call sites (Dispatcher.ts ~2203, ~3076) are unguarded and run after the tick's work landed, so a throw loses the TickResult the strict twin deliberately cannot lose. The function's doc comment already claims every failure degrades this way.
